exposure: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) classification (accreta, increta, percreta)
MRI descriptors (placenta accreta, cross-border blood vessels through uterine muscle layer, interruption of hyperechoic uterus-bladder interface, subplacental hypervascularity)
cohort: 164 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorder undergoing cesarean section.
finding: Preoperative MRI descriptors, such as placenta accreta classification, cross-border blood vessels, interruption of the uterus-bladder interface, and subplacental hypervascularity, are positively associated with and can predict intraoperative blood loss in PAS patients.
mod_finding: The study's findings demonstrate the predictive value of MRI descriptors for estimating intraoperative blood loss specifically during cesarean section for PAS patients.
